project_type: Next.js 15 app (see AGENTS.md — treat as unknown version, read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before any Next.js-specific code). Supabase backend. TypeScript throughout.
build_system: next build (npm run build). No custom bundler quirks beyond standard Next.js.
test_framework: vitest — command: npm run test (alias: vitest --run). Test files co-located with source, e.g. src/lib/invoice/outstanding.test.ts.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` from x:\Safend\project\main — must exit 0. 2. Run `npm run test` — all tests must pass. 3. No new type errors introduced.
environment_constraints: Use supabaseClient (imported from @/integrations/supabase/client) throughout ManageReceivables.tsx — NOT the server client. Never restart the dev server. Windows shell — use PowerShell syntax.
contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md says this is a non-standard Next.js version — read node_modules/next/dist/docs/ before adding any Next.js API calls. Do NOT change payment-settlement.ts or calculations.ts.
key_patterns: Supabase queries use chained builder: .from('receivables').select(...).eq(...).in(...). JSONB containment filter: .filter('previous_balance_breakdown', 'cs', JSON.stringify([{key: val}])). Balance notes parsed with regex /Balance:\s*₹?([\d,]+(?:\.\d+)?)/ (see parseBalanceFromNotes in outstanding.ts). Both referenceNumber and reference_number key names appear in previous_balance_breakdown JSONB — must handle both. Error-wrapping pattern: wrap best-effort work in try/catch; never block primary flow.
directory_structure: src/lib/invoice/ — pure TS calculation/query helpers (outstanding.ts, payment-settlement.ts, calculations.ts, rateBasis.ts). src/modules/accounts/components/ — React components for accounts module. app/api/invoice-pdf/route.ts — server-side PDF generation. supabase/migrations/ — schema history.
